source_snapshot.criteria: All items should be passed without system hang or reboot.
source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 5 attended and 15 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; identifies NVIDIA qualification tooling/operator and generic per-iteration link/device/error evidence.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; held Pending because Test #28 does not say whether it is passive AER observation or controlled fault/reset stimulus.

old_problem: NVQual Test #28 names an AER check but the approved source does not establish whether the operation is passive observation of naturally occurring AER or controlled error/reset stimulus. Those meanings have different commands, expected deltas, blast radius, authorization and recovery; clearing logs would also destroy the required baseline.
disposition_reason: ED-16 permits RAS/error injection only with an approved tool, isolated environment and recovery, while ED-17 requires preserving evidence before any deletion. Parameterization can bind topology, registers and thresholds, but it cannot decide whether this testcase merely observes AER or deliberately creates it. Resolving that core operation would require inventing coverage or risk, so the decision remains Pending.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2131, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2132 / Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00009-V002 / 597068a74a1a8452 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
The owner must choose passive observation or a specifically approved fault/reset stimulus; the two are not interchangeable and must not be inferred from the AER title.

For either mode bind the exact root-port/switch/endpoint/GPU path, AER capabilities, registers, masks/severity, baseline, allowed/expected deltas, observation window or stimulus timing, iterations and final state.
Preserve/hash preexisting AER, kernel, BMC and SEL evidence. The source instruction to clear logs is prohibited until evidence is exported and separately authorized.

If passive, run read-only baseline/observation and require no disqualifying new AER. If stimulus-based, require the exact approved injector/tool/scenario, expected records and recovery before any action.
Stop on unexpected/fatal AER, DPC/link/device loss, hang/reboot, thermal/power fault, tool failure or evidence gap; preserve first-fault evidence and never retry automatically.
No NVQual/AER read, log clearing, injection, reset, reboot, power cycle, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.test_name: Mode-explicit HGX NVQual Test #28 PCIe AER validation
test_case.purpose: Validate the owner-approved PCIe AER policy on the mapped HGX path by preserving and attributing baseline and per-window or per-stimulus AER evidence while proving expected NVIDIA links/devices remain healthy without hang or unplanned reboot.
required_package: Pinned NVIDIA NVQual Test #28 package/configuration with compatible firmware/driver
Owner decision selecting passive observation or the exact approved controlled stimulus
Signed root-port/switch/endpoint/GPU identity and AER capability/register/severity map
Approved baseline, allowed or expected delta, timing/iteration, device/link/error acceptance and final-state contract
For stimulus mode only: approved injector/tool/scenario, isolated SUT, BMC/console and recovery runbook
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED pending the engineering decision selecting passive observation or an approved controlled stimulus. Preserve/hash baseline AER registers/counters and OS/BMC/SEL logs; do not clear them. After selection and point approval, run only the pinned Test #28 mode and record raw per-device AER fields/deltas, exact observation/stimulus timing, link/device identities, NVIDIA health and correlated OS/BMC evidence. Stop on first anomaly; do not inject, reset, clear evidence or retry unless explicitly included in the signed mode.
test_case.expected_result: For passive mode, the approved observation completes with no disqualifying new AER and all mapped devices/links healthy. For stimulus mode, only the authorized AER records/deltas occur with correct attribution and the specified recovery/final state. In both modes all Test #28 items are accepted with no hang, unplanned reboot or unexplained evidence loss.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until the passive-versus-stimulus decision and mode-specific oracle are approved. PASS requires complete attributable evidence satisfying the selected mode. FAIL on unexpected/missing/wrong-severity or wrong-target AER, DPC/link/device loss, hang/reboot, failed recovery or disqualifying evidence gap. Missing mode/oracle is BLOCKED; an empty log after clearing is never PASS.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until the owner selects passive observation or names the exact approved stimulus and mode-specific expected deltas/recovery.
Preserve/hash all existing AER, kernel, BMC and SEL evidence before any separately authorized deletion.
Any stimulus requires an isolated SUT, approved injector/tool/target, console and tested recovery; passive mode cannot silently escalate.
Stop without reset/power escalation or automatic retry on first unexpected event.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, owner-approved Test #28 mode, manifest/configuration and authorization
HGX/tool/firmware/driver/BMC identities plus complete AER-capable topology and stable device map
Preserved raw baseline registers/status/counters/logs and signed field/severity/delta/timing/iteration oracle
Per-window or per-stimulus raw AER deltas with exact target, timestamps, link/device/NVIDIA/OS/BMC correlation
Mode-specific first-fault/recovery or clean final AER/link/device/host state, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On unexpected/fatal AER, DPC, link/device loss, hang/reboot, wrong-target stimulus, tool failure or evidence gap, inhibit further activity and preserve the first event. Do not clear, inject again, reset or power-cycle automatically; follow the signed mode-specific recovery and quarantine if expected topology/health is not restored.

source_conflict.reason: Items and Test #28 consistently identify AER validation; the missing passive-versus-stimulus semantic is under-specification, not contradictory preserved sources.

blocked.reason: Static review can state the unresolved decision and safe gates. Execution is blocked by the mode decision, but the record itself is not classified as globally BLOCKED.
